# Explicit lockfile for setup-miniconda: it matches /^@EXPLICIT/ in the contents and switches to
# `conda create --file`, which skips the repodata fetch and the solve entirely. Platform-specific by
# construction, so there is one of these per conda job.

# Pinned to exact builds, so it does NOT track new conda-smithy or rattler-build releases. Regenerate
# with `conda list --explicit --name tesseract-build` on the matching platform after updating
# environment.yml, which stays the source of truth for what the build tooling is.
